1.Name: Mired
1.TopDescripition: Due to mired terrain, teams cannot move between cities during a Raging Rainstorm.

2.TopDescripition: After a Raging Rainstorm ends, random cities on the battlefield will become Flooded, greatly reducing the defenses of affected cities.

3.Name: Flooded
3.TopDescripition: The durability of some city buildings is reduced by 80%.

4.TopDescripition: The skies are clear. No effects are applied.

5.TopDescripition: Cloud Cover is being generated. After 1 day, a Raging Rainstorm will arrive, during which teams cannot be moved between cities.

6.Name: Calamitous Flood
6.TopDescripition: A Calamitous Flood has occurred, leaving random cities on the battlefield in the Flooded state.

7.Name: Hazy Mist
7.TopDescripition: Hazy Mist has appeared on the battlefield, hiding the movements of enemy troops and placing random Cities under the Mist Shroud effect.

8.TopDescripition: A radiant glow shines from behind the clouds. Lucky Rainbow weather is forecast for Goldsand Province tomorrow.

9.TopDescripition: A Lucky Rainbow has appeared! All resource zones have gained the Lucky Boost effect!

10.Name: Mist Shroud
10.TopDescripition: Due to Hazy Mist, visibility is limited in this City, and a random nearby resource zone may be robbed by players from another League. A successful robbery will reduce the resource zone's durability, and once durability is reduced to zero, the resource zone will halt production for 1 day.
